text:
evan: New docs PR for dedicated provisioning migration: added a tiny Rust SDK example (requested), clarified eviction vs preemption, and documented fallback behaviors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/589
mia: Nice. Can you paste the Rust snippet here so infra can sanity-check names?
evan: Sure. I tried to keep it minimal:
```rust
use redwood_rs::Client;
use std::env;
fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
  let key = env::var("REDWOOD_KEY")?;
  let client = Client::new(&key);
  // blocking reserve call in SDK v0.10
  client.reserve_capacity_blocking("team-omega", 2, vec![("team","embed"),("env","prod")])?;
  Ok(())
}
```
rafa: SDK naming: in v0.10 the call is ReserveCapacitySync not reserve_capacity_blocking. Also the tuple vec for labels isn't idiomatic; prefer a HashMap.
evan: Got it — I'll switch to ReserveCapacitySync and HashMap and push.
ci-bot: link-checker: 1 broken anchor -> handbook/provisioning.md#tenant-isolation-example should be handbook/provisioning.md#tenant-isolation. Automated suggestion applied.
mia: For the eviction vs preemption blurb, can we make two one-line triggers so users can quickly see the difference? e.g., preemption = cloud provider reclaims spot GPU; eviction = node drained for kernel/security patch or tenant policy violation. Keep neutral phrasing.
evan: Added those triggers. Also added a short SLA note: "Example: if Base SLA=99.95% and region allows 0.05% preemption, Adjusted SLA ~= 99.90% (informal)." Marked as illustrative only.
rafa: Product note: add fallback policy key name and example. We currently use fallback_policy: regional_compatible in the config schema. Include example YAML and a canary rollout snippet (rollout_fraction).
evan: Added YAML snippet:
```yaml
provisioning:
  mode: dedicated
  fallback_policy: regional_compatible
  autoscale:
    policy: target_utilization
    cooldown_seconds: 90
rollout:
  canary:
    enabled: true
    rollout_fraction: 0.02
tenant_isolation: hard # hard: per-tenant node isolation, soft: shared nodes with limits
```
mia: docs should use 'hard'/'soft' to match infra API. Great. Can you also add a tiny staging test plan for autoscale cooldown? e.g., simulate burst then verify scale-down respects cooldown_seconds and doesn't oscillate.
ev an: Added a 3-step test plan under appendix. Left TODO to populate region preemption allowances table.
rafa: LGTM once Rust snippet naming and labels fixed. Also add a one-line note that fallback to regional pools may change effective latency.
evan: Fixed Rust snippet and pushed. CI will run lint and link-check; will merge after approval from @mia. Thanks all.
